skillsbench-host-grading.name: skillsbench-host-grading
key_points: Graded deliverables MUST live as top-level entries of the task dir (`tasks/<id>/`), because `stage_task_for_host_eval` copies those into `<stage>/root/` (which `/root` and `/app` remap to). `environment/`, `solution/`, `tests/`, `instruc...

When the instruction names an absolute container dir (e.g. `/root/output/<f>`), ALWAYS mirror it as a same-named top-level task-dir dir (`output/<f>`) so the remapped test path resolves after staging.
NEVER rely on a pre-generated answer the image ships under `environment/` (e.g. `environment/output/`): stage your own copy at the task-dir path the test reads.
A passing host run MUST show `tests_total > 0` with `tests_failed == 0`; a `main()`-only script collecting 0 items reports exit 5 and scores 0.

Deliverables the instruction names by absolute container path (e.g. `/root/results.json`) MUST be staged as same-named top-level task-dir entries (`results.json`); the stager remaps `/root` → `<stage>/root`, nothing else places them there.
